topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I just found out I'm being transferred to the other side of the building. Great, now I get to start all over again with a bunch of new faces, teaching them my process from scratch. I guess my current team can manage without me—after everything we've built together. Just my luck to be reassigned right when things were finally clicking. I suppose I should be grateful for the change, right? It's not like I have a choice. Looks like I'll be spending my weekend prepping for this brilliant transition. Can't wait to see how this mess plays out.
